messages:
Ellen: Quick thread — interview with Cascade.ai done. Need: signed release, one homepage pull quote, two social lines, and webinar interest check. Target publish: next Thu AM. Recording + notes: https://drive.google.com/cascade-interview :clipboard:

Ravi: Got it. They mentioned "cut inference cost by ~60%" and asked to avoid naming previous vendor.

Maya (CS): Correct. They prefer anonymized baseline. Also asked about a short technical quote about batching improvements.

Jon (Legal): Uploading release template with a short speaker addendum: https://drive.google.com/open?id=cascade-release. If we keep metrics as "~60% lower" that's fine; if they want exact comps we need supporting docs and explicit sign-off.

Ellen: Cool. Ravi will draft two quote options (cost-focused and dev-time-focused). Please paste into the doc for customer selection.

Ravi: Pasted: 
> "Redwood lowered our inference spend by ~60% while improving tail latency."
> "With Redwood we launched a conversational pilot in under three weeks."

Maya (CS): Sent the release to their PM and marketing lead. They replied: "Approve anonymized metric and signed release attached." Attached: https://drive.google.com/file/d/cascade-release-signed.pdf

PromoBot: Transcript and assets processed: /files/3555557777-cascade-transcript.txt, /marketing/assets/cascade-quote.png

Jon (Legal): Reviewed signed release. Cleared language: "Redwood lowered our inference spend by ~60% while improving tail latency." Good to go for blog, social, and webinar promo.

Ellen: Awesome. Ravi — finalize the pull quote and two tweet lines by EOD. I'll set HubSpot routing tag=case-study/Cascade, owner=EMEA SDRs and attach the release + transcript.

Ravi: Done. Pull quote updated in doc and tweet lines added.

Maya (CS): I'll prepare a 30-min webinar slot and speaker bio. Will share slides Monday.

Ellen: Scheduling the launch for Thu 9am and internal heads-up to Sales for Wed. Closing once assets live. Thanks team!
